about.title: The story of <1>Mimir</1>
about.intro: In Norse mythology, Mímir is the giant of wisdom and the guardian of the well of knowledge. Inspired by him, we built a platform that uses artificial intelligence to synthesise your knowledge base and turn it into structured, ready-to-use exam material.

local.title: Local architecture
local.desc: Every Qwen AI model and the vector database run on your side, for maximum data protection.

engine.title: Modern AI engine
engine.desc: The Wellspring, RuneCarver and Bifrost microservices work together to produce hallucination-free results.

teachers.title: Built for educators
teachers.desc: We built it so teachers and instructors can save hours of exam writing.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Because Mimir runs on your own hardware (locally), there are no hidden cloud costs or API fees. Choose the support plan that fits your needs.

sections.heading: 1. General provisions
sections.body: Mimir AI pays special attention to protecting personal data. Because our service is built on an architecture that can run locally, uploaded teaching materials and exam questions are not sent to external cloud servers; they are processed on your own infrastructure.

sections.heading: 2. Data we process
list: The email address and encrypted password provided during registration.
The name and email address provided in the contact form.
Session (cookie) identifiers stored while using the website.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of processing
sections.body: Managing user accounts, providing access to the service, and communicating with users (for example password resets and technical support).

sections.heading: 4. Data security
sections.body: Passwords stored in the database are hashed with bcrypt. All communication with the service takes place over encrypted channels.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Use carefully before using the Mimir AI service.

sections.heading: 1. Description of the service
sections.body: Mimir is an AI-assisted test generation platform. It can automatically generate questions and exam material from uploaded documents using the Qwen AI model.

sections.heading: 2. User responsibility
sections.body: Users may only upload material for which they hold the appropriate copyright or licence. Professional review of the generated exam material is always the user's responsibility.

sections.heading: 3. Generated content
sections.body: Although the system uses hallucination-reducing mechanisms (RAG), large language models are inherently imperfect, so Mimir does not guarantee that generated exam questions are 100% factually accurate. Human review is mandatory before using the material in a real exam.

sections.heading: 4. Service availability
sections.body: The free plan is provided "as is", without a guaranteed service level (SLA). Pro subscribers receive the technical support set out in their contract.
